FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Crafty Creations Studio, we specialize in providing a wide variety of hobby and craft supplies, including materials for model-building, scrapbooking, knitting, and painting. Our store features an inviting space where customers can explore our extensive inventory, including high-quality products sourced from reputable vendors. We prioritize safety by strictly adhering to local fire and safety codes, ensuring that our premises are well-maintained with clear aisles and proper lighting, minimizing the risk of accidents. Additionally, all instructional classes and workshops we offer are covered by professional liability insurance, further safeguarding our operations. We have robust inventory control systems in place, with regular stock audits conducted to prevent shrinkage. Importantly, we do not engage in the sales or rentals of hazardous materials exceeding minimal, consumer-safe quantities, thereby protecting our customers and employees from potential risks associated with chemical exposure. Our commitment to customer service, safety, and regulatory compliance makes us a trusted destination for all craft enthusiasts.

Our craft and hobby store offers a wide range of art supplies, including various paints and adhesives that may contain hazardous materials in larger quantities for specialized projects and customer needs.
